rows.text: Hm. Kid bleed. Need a pressure rag, now.
Hm. Moth's oil is smoldering now.
Hm. Small broth for the kid.
Hm. That meat is rotting out there.
Hm. Pip down in the fat. That raider took her.
Hm. Raw pork's a mess. Stop that.
Hm. Stop yelling like a starving goat.
Hm. Moth's gone out in the frost.
Hm. Meat or bone, get down from the pen.
Hm. Level ten metal work. Like a good roast, steady work.
Hm. Eat that insect jelly before it gets cold.
Okay so Ash, like, you're bleeding out...
Okay so Tuk's gonna be totally fine, right, I hope that's true...
Okay so Ash looks really rough in there, like those wounds just won't close up...
Okay so Tuk looks like she totally needs a distraction, like for real...
Okay so Ash is actually down there now, like all alone in the dirt...
Okay so Tuk is totally feral right now, she's gonna make us all hungry...
Okay so Ash, did you totally just break the table again...
Okay so Tuk just walked out in that wind... is she gonna freeze...
Okay so raiders, like, right out of the fog, are heading our way...
Okay so this workbench is like, totally familiar now...
Okay so this dirt is pretty hard for a plate, but at least Biscuit is happy...
Okay so this insect jelly is totally weird but it's better than nothing, huh...
Copy. Moth down. Focus fire on remaining three.
Lux, slow. Stop rolling in dirt.
Moth, check wound again. Two herbal left. Negative on more.
Movement required. Body needs moving to the ground.
Moth down. Blood slick. East field. One down.
Lux. Fifty percent empty pantry. Not enough raw meat.
Chair velocity high. Stay clear of destruction.
Negative. He exposed himself. Four hundred meters to the gate.
Copy. Bench finished. Ten crafts done.
I think... I should probably get some pressure on that wound.
I think, well, that's quite bad, Rook, maybe you should stop right there.
I think, maybe I should check on Tuk again?
I think, maybe we should probably move the body to the grave.
I think the blood here... maybe we should clean it up.
I think, maybe we should put more stew on the stove before he just keeps eating raw things.
I think, maybe we should just stop the game?
I think, well, probably he'll be in trouble for leaving without a coat.
I think we should probably get inside before they get closer, maybe help Tuk get the weapons.
I think, well, probably this bench feels a little more... settled now.
I think, probably we just don't have a table today, does it?
I think maybe that jelly is probably fine, I mean, it's just... weird.
He bleeds. Get him back.
Pip burning. Stop screaming. I take her to the fire.
Lux is burning up and the wound is deep.
Pip looks at the dead one. Tuk walks closer.
Tuk looks at the red on the grass. Not good meat.
The little one needs less noise and more raw meat.
That soft one always makes a fuss over cheap wood.
Pip leaves in the cold. She needs a good coat before she goes high.
Raiders move. Tuk sees spears. Time to kill.
This dirt is bad meat for sitting.
Kibble bad meat. Tuk wants something else. comfort
Naturally, this latest disruption to my artistic contemplation is quite bothersome.
Naturally, my dear Ash, one does not expect a mere cooking implement to achieve such spectacular combustion.
Naturally, one hopes that the current malady does not necessitate the complete forfeiture of a serviceable armchair.
Naturally, one must wonder how a body becomes so tragically unremarkable in such grim circumstances.
Naturally, one does find the field of dead quite lacking in aesthetic merit.
Naturally, this cacophony of raw meat consumption is dreadfully vulgar for a supper. gossip
Naturally, the spectacle of your tantrum has quite ruined my composition, my dear Rook.
Naturally, the pointless departure of that shudder of a man only confirms the futility of it all.
Naturally, the dawn presents a rather spectacular display of savagery, my dear Rook.
Naturally, one finds the sensation of proficiency quite unmoored when the surroundings lack even a suitable surface.
Naturally, one finds one’s sustenance best savored upon something marginally more refined than this honest dirt. gossip
Naturally, this raw jelly and grit constitute a most peculiar repast for one of my standing.
